summaries.en: **summary_en** authentik is an open-source identity provider that centralizes authentication and authorization across your applications, solving the problem of managing separate logins. Technically, it acts as a flexible “glue” layer, speaking OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, and LDAP while also functioning as a reverse proxy to protect non-standard services. You can deploy it on Kubernetes or Docker, connect existing directories, and quickly enable single sign-on for internal tools or customer-facing portals. **summary_zh** authentik 是一个开源身份提供者，用来统一管理各应用的登录认证与权限控制，避免每套系统单独维护账号的麻烦。它的核心优势在于“粘合”：既能作为 OAuth2/OIDC、SAML、LDAP 的认证服务端，也能充当反向代理，把不支持标准协议的旧服务纳入统一认证体系。部署上对 Kubernetes 和 Docker 都很友好，支持对接现有用户目录。你可以在自建服务器上轻松起一个实例，然后为内网工具、管理后台或客户门户配置单点登录，体验一把“一个账号走天下”的效率提升。

summaries.en: **summary_en** Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF makes a 35-billion-parameter conversational language model practical for everyday hardware. By converting the model into quantized GGUF format, it slashes memory and compute requirements while keeping most generative quality. You can run it locally using llama.cpp or other GGUF-compatible runtimes for real-time text generation without cloud dependency. It’s ideal for building offline chatbots, private AI assistants, or experimenting with large-model capabilities on a single consumer GPU. The MIT license even lets you integrate it into commercial tools. **summary_zh** Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF 把 35B 参数的大语言模型压缩成 GGUF 量化格式，让它在普通消费级硬件上也能流畅运行，解决了大模型部署门槛高、依赖云端的问题。你只需搭配 llama.cpp 等推理框架，即可本地完成对话与文本生成，同时保留较高的输出质量。无论是打造离线聊天机器人、隐私敏感的本地助手，还是快速验证大模型产品原型，它都是顺手的选择。MIT 协议更让商用集成毫无障碍，值得一试。
